meta.title: Draft Lab
meta.description: Explore Deadlock team compositions: measured synergy, matchups, role coverage and data-backed next picks with confidence levels.

title: Draft Lab
description: Pick heroes for both teams to see how they have performed together and against each other in public matches. These are statistical associations, not coaching: players, lanes and items matter and aren’t captured here.
scopeNote: Scope: {scope}. Numbers under heroes are their win rates in this scope.
howItWorks: How it works: each pair’s win rate is compared with the expectation from the two heroes’ individual win rates (same team: wr₁ + wr₂ − 50%; opposing: wr₁ − wr₂ + 50%). A relationship counts only when its 95% interval excludes that expectation, the gap is at least 1 percentage point, and it has 200+ matches. Pairs need 100+ matches to appear at all.

panels.relationsDescription: Pairs whose results differ clearly from what each hero’s own win rate predicts.
panels.recsDescription: Heroes with clear positive results alongside your picks or against the enemy’s. Ordered by confidence, then by measured gap.

recs.needPicks: Pick at least one hero on either side. Suggestions come only from how heroes perform with or against the current picks.
recs.none: No hero has clear positive evidence with these picks. That means the data doesn’t separate the options, not that any choice is wrong.

rule.high: At least 2 clear positive relationships and no clear negative one.
rule.moderate: At least 1 clear positive relationship, more positives than negatives.

recs.newRole: Would be your first {role}. Role coverage is shown as a fact; it isn’t scored.
recs.otherPairings: {count} other {count, plural, one {pairing} other {pairings}} not clear

weak.needAllies: Add heroes to your team to check for measured weak points.
weak.none: No measured weak points: no enemy clearly beats your picks, no pair of your picks clearly underperforms together, and no balance measure is in the bottom quarter.
weak.lowDetail: Your picks average the {percentile}th percentile of heroes on this per-match measure.

roles.caption: Heroes per role on each team

balance.needPicks: Pick heroes to see their measured profile.
balance.note: Average percentile of each team’s heroes among all heroes (50 = typical), from per-match averages in this scope. Longer matches raise every total. Utility such as healing or crowd control isn’t in the data, so it isn’t measured.

map.legend: Arcs: same-team pairs · straight: matchups · thicker = bigger gap · faded = moderate sample
map.none: No clear relationships among these picks. {checked} pairings checked, {withData} with enough data; every one is within what the heroes’ individual win rates predict.
map.summary: {count} of {checked} pairings differ clearly from expectation; the rest are within noise or lack data and aren’t drawn.
